entry_state: The tax disclosures do not supply payment distributions. Northstar reuses one unknown financing share across statements, while awards and valuations retain their own conditions and admitted inputs. Subsequent return settlement closes refund and recovery balances with explicit handling classification. The impairment-reversal method still leaves an all-zero carrying-weight allocation unresolved; the surrounding subsequent-event section continues next.
exit_state: Subsequent methods preserve impairment weights, surrendered lease rights, cost-asset ceilings and tax origins. The onerous-contract example writes down the existing asset before recognizing the remaining unavoidable loss and follows fulfilment, cancellation and changed estimates. Rule selection has now introduced authority requirements and source identities; its ordering and historical-view consequences continue on page 170.
findings: A reversal ceiling does not justify equal or headroom weights when all carrying amounts are zero; the individual-asset rule is explicitly different.
Repeated lease changes retain surrendered right-specific amounts and recompute the surviving schedule rather than applying one physical percentage.
The onerous-contract case prevents double-counting the cost-asset loss and distinguishes minimum unavoidable loss from management's eventual action.
Tax benefit origin, recognition conditions and gross balances remain separate from net presentation. No new confirmed defect.

equation.exposition_role: Mechanism-bearing scoped asset-test and onerous-provision sequence.
equation.symbols_units_domain: All symbols are currency amounts; A' is retained cost asset, F remaining fulfilment loss and P provision.
equation.assumptions_timing: Before service, no material discounting or omitted taxes/FX/reimbursements; other required impairment tests and enforceable cancellation facts are supplied.
equation.source_and_equality: A'=min(A0,max(B-D,0)), F=max(D+A'-B,0), P=min(F,K) give 0,30,30 for A0=20,B=100,D=130,K=50.
equation.interpretation: The asset loss A0-A' has already reached profit; provision comparison uses net fulfilment loss, not gross cost alone.
equation.transition: The following completion, cancellation and improvement cases show distinct later consequences.
